run_training: run the image autoencoder training script with configurable epochs, batch size, and discriminator options
build_autoencoder: build an AutoEncoder model with configurable layers, filters, skip connections, and deconvolution method
build_latent_discriminator: build a LatentDiscriminator model with configurable hidden dimension and dropout rate
train_adversarial: train the autoencoder with latent, patch, and classifier discriminator adversarial steps
evaluate_model: evaluate the trained autoencoder model using an external classifier on validation data
